"Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit, Proshares Executive Director Tactical Products Inkoo Kang, and Baird Strategas Chief Strategist Todd Sohn.
